regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Breckenridge leads with 7" over the window, with 6" on Wednesday. Snow arrives Monday with gusty northwest wind, and the NWS has a Winter Weather Advisory from Monday through Tuesday. Vail has 7" and Arapahoe Basin 5". Wednesday brings snow showers at all three.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler leads the Coast Mountains with 10" over the window, with 5" on Thursday. Environment Canada expects a mix of sun and cloud early in the week, then showers and periods of rain. Cypress Mountain sees rain for much of the week, with 2" on Thursday.
